description: A doppler simulator. A path is drawn on the grid and a sound source travels along it; the stereo output carries the pitch shift, the fall in level and the delay between the ears that produces

params.text: Scales the grid, from a quarter of size up to four times
The base speed the source travels the path at, in km/h
Attenuates the voltage arriving at the speed input before it is added to the base speed
Starts the source moving, from the beginning of the path
Stops the source where it is, and starts it again from there
Puts the source back to the start of the path
Sends the source round the path again each time it reaches the end
Switched off, the pitch shift from the source's movement is dropped and only the level and the delay remain
Switched on, the delay between the two ears is worked out for every position of the source in space; switched off, both ears are treated as the same distance away
Switched off, the fall in level with distance between the source and the listener is dropped
Prints the length of the path, the source's speed at that moment, how far it has travelled, its distance from the listener, and its speed towards the listener
Runs the source along the path the other way

inputs.text: One side of the stereo input carrying the sound the source gives out
0-10V here is added to the base speed of the source, through its attenuator
A pulse starts the source moving, from the beginning of the path
A pulse stops the source where it is, and the next one starts it again from there
A pulse puts the source back to the start of the path
A voltage runs the source along the path the other way

outputs.text: One side of the stereo output, carrying the sound as the listener hears it

notes: the path the source travels is drawn on the grid: a right-click on the grid offers the commands that add and remove points, and a point already on the path is dragged to move it
each square of the grid stands for 10 metres
the source stays at the start of the path until START is pressed or a pulse arrives at the start input
menu: Add Point — adds a point to the path drawn on the grid
Remove Point — takes a point off the path drawn on the grid
Clear All — takes every point off the path, leaving no path for the source to travel
